about: Stages. v0.1 has one: a clearing in the fog, at Katamari scale (James is a few cm tall), with real Katamari objects placed in rings by the size you need to roll them up. Numbers follow Katamari's first stages: Make a Star 1 (REROLL mission data: 5 cm start, 10 cm goal, 30 cm cap, ratings 10/12/14/15 cm) and Once Upon A KATAMARI's 'As Large As Possible 1' (15 cm in 4 minutes).

map.about: Garry's Mod map it runs on (ships with Garry's Mod)

center.about: stage centre in Source units (x, y, z of the floor)

rating_cm.about: result bands: goal, good, great, best

max_cm.about: growth after the goal follows rules.after_goal_curve and stops here

tiers.about: object rings placed for this stage

ground_size_m.about: side of the square ground plane

radio.about: radio static that rises as time runs out
